verdict.rationale: The only story-relevant evidence is a marketing example prompt, "Score our open deals and send proposals to anyone above 80%". It implies a monday agent can act across a set of items from one natural-language instruction, and a related doc says agents can be described in plain words to automate workflows. The GraphQL API is a developer building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented bulk edit/update/delete across many items (UI or API), batch mutation limits or semantics, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-item operations.
